title: Person: Mr Casey
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Mr Casey

anchor.prefix: eck with his fingers. And Stephen smiled too for he knew now that it was not true that Mr Casey had a purse of silver in his throat. He smiled to think how the silvery noise which
anchor.suffix: used to make had deceived him. And when he had tried to open Mr Casey’s hand to see if the purse of silver was hidden there he had seen that the fingers could not be straightened
